name: monorepo-scope
description: Detects which monorepo package you're in and scopes test, lint and build commands to it.

autoScope.title: Rewrite root commands
autoScope.description: Rewrite root-level test/lint/build commands to the current package. Off: leave them and tell Claude the scoped command instead.

scripts.title: Scoped scripts
scripts.description: Comma-separated scripts and tasks to scope.
